positive_cases.prompt: 审计Web of Science导出的放射组学语料，核对数据库覆盖、检索式、日期、DOI去重和缺失引用。
描述2018-2025年影像AI论文与引用趋势，使用可解释的归一化和时间窗，不做科研质量排名。
分析多中心MRI研究的作者和机构合作网络，处理医院别名、联盟作者和超大团队。
对医学影像基础模型语料做共词和文献耦合地图，报告聚类参数和社区稳定性。
比较五家影像研究机构的产出和引用影响，避免让规模和学科构成主导结论。
研究放射学AI主题网络十年演变，区分真实变化和数据库扩容、关键词漂移。
复现一篇VOSviewer影像文献计量图，并检验阈值、计数、resolution和seed改变后是否稳定。
required_checks: frozen prior corpus and software version

boundary_cases.prompt: 系统检索所有数据库并交付可复现的影像AI文献语料。
基于最新研究判断下一个真正有价值的影像科研创新问题。
系统评价影像AI诊断准确性并做meta分析和GRADE证据结论。
核对这条引用的DOI、作者、题名、页码并导出参考文献。
根据已经冻结的节点边数据制作可投稿的网络Figure并做视觉QA。
只按影响因子和引用数自动决定谁最优秀并淘汰其余申请人。

invariants: A versioned corpus passport precedes every metric or network
Database platform index query retrieval date and coverage are reported
Counts from different databases are not silently treated as the same corpus
DOI normalization precedes composite non-DOI duplicate resolution
Work versions corrections retractions and conference-to-article families are explicit
Author and institution disambiguation never relies on names alone
ORCID and ROR assertion provenance is retained
Ambiguous identity clusters remain visible and receive sensitivity analysis
Full and fractional counting are declared with unit denominator and consortium policy
Citation comparison specifies field document year source and census window
Recent publications are recognized as citation right-censored
Network nodes edges weights self-loops thresholds and pruning are explicit
Normalization layout and clustering are separate analytical choices
Clustering algorithm resolution seed and stability are reported
A visual cluster is not assumed to be a natural or stable scientific field
Citation centrality journal metrics and altmetrics do not establish quality
Publication growth does not prove novelty clinical adoption or innovation
Bibliometric maps do not answer intervention diagnostic or prognostic effect questions
Radiology venue modality task and clinical-stage coverage asymmetries are explicit
Consortium and hyperauthorship sensitivity is required when it can dominate networks
Quantitative indicators supplement rather than replace expert qualitative judgment
The skill does not make automated hiring funding or individual merit decisions
